meta.name: cro
meta.description: When the user wants to optimize, improve, or increase conversions on any marketing page or form — including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, lead capture forms, or contact forms. Also use when the user says 'CRO,' 'conversion rate optimization,' 'this page isn't converting,' 'improve conversions,' 'why isn't this page working,' 'my landing page sucks,' 'form abandonment,' 'nobody's converting,' 'low conversion rate,' or 'this page needs work.' Use this even if the user just shares a URL and asks for feedback. For signup/registration flows, see signup. For post-signup activation, see onboarding. For popups/modals, see popups.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化营销页面与表单,让更多访客转化为客户
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果页面有流量但转化不理想,想系统性地找出原因并改进。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize your marketing pages and forms to turn more visitors into customers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pages get traffic but not enough conversions, and you want to fix that.

howto.what: Claude会作为转化率优化专家,先确认页面类型、主要转化目标和流量来源,再依据价值主张清晰度、标题、CTA、视觉层级、信任信号、摩擦点等框架分析营销页面,最终输出快速改进、高影响改动、测试想法与文案备选。
howto.when: 当用户想优化或提高营销页面/表单的转化,或说出“CRO”“转化率优化”等关键词,甚至只发链接求反馈时触发;注册流程、激活、弹窗等另有技能,不适用。

say.text: 分析一下这个落地页为什么没人转化
say.note: Claude会按CRO框架评估页面并给出建议

say.text: 看看我们定价页的CTA文案能怎么优化
say.note: 会得到快速改进、高影响改动和文案备选

say.text: 这个首页的转化率很低,帮我诊断
say.note: 会先问转化目标和流量来源再分析

howto.what_en: Claude as CRO expert: identifies page type, goal, traffic source; analyzes via value clarity, headline, CTA, visual hierarchy, trust, friction; outputs quick wins, high-impact changes, test ideas, copy alternatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants better conversions on marketing pages/forms, or says terms like 'CRO' or 'conversion rate optimization,' or shares a URL for feedback. Not for signup, onboarding, or popup topics.

say_en.text: Analyze why this landing page isn't converting.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates the page via the CRO framework.

say_en.text: How can we improve CTA copy on our pricing page?
say_en.note: You'll get quick wins and copy alternatives.
It asks about your goal and traffic first.
